profile.headline: Founding Partner at Secreteq
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary:
My interest in application development originated from my passion for strategy games. Between developing and contemplating the next best move, I often tend to get my tan on from the light of my laptop.

These days, I am looking to expand my experience in creating awesome user experiences, cloud development, and artificial intelligence.

Specialties: .NET, Angular, React, Azure, SQL, Mongo, Cosmos, Docker

positions.title: Founding Partner
positions.description: Designed and developed a full-stack Pokémon GO team-building application using Blazor, C#, and .NET 10, enabling users to construct and evaluate competitive Pokémon teams. Architected and deployed the application using Microsoft Azure, implementing automated CI/CD pipelines through Azure DevOps for streamlined deployments. Integrated Azure AI Foundry to explore LLM-powered team recommendations and demonstrate practical applications of generative AI within an existing software architecture.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilize C#, Azure, .Net, Ionic 2, Angular 2 to rewrite solutions for the cloud
Technical lead role within an agile environment of 12 different teams in 3 different locations; 100+ members total
Merge and integrate code to different environments using Perforce, CCNet, and Jenkins

positions.title: Experienced Application Developer
positions.description:
Utilize SiteCore, .Net, C#, and KnockoutJS to maintain and make enhancements to web components and major websites such boxtops4education.com, quericavida.com, and tablespoon.com
Utilize Dynatrace, Coradiant, SCOM, and Jenkins to monitor, build, and deploy code in line with GMI software quality standards
Create and update technical documentation for process flow and system snapshots while working as part of an agile team of 20+ developers

Technical Skills: C#, MVC, .NET 4.5, SQL, WCF, REST, SOA, Knockout, jQuery, HTML5, LESS

positions.title: Application Developer I
positions.description:
Provided technical guidance for incoming Retail Trade application developers
Utilized .Net, C#, JavaScript, and Oracle expertise to support over 160 different applications
Utilized .Net and Oracle expertise for development of the SOX-controlled Retail Trade application
Created and updated technical documentation on process flow and system snapshots
Fixed user acceptance testing issues for incoming Retail Trade bugs and issues
Handled deployment of Trade related applications and database changes to production
Lead and documented the Oracle-heavy Retail Trade Pre-Load process
Lead front-end user experience and web service development for the SOX-controlled Planning Calendar web application

Technical Skills: MVC, VB.NET (2.0, 4.0, and 4.5), PLSQL, WCF, REST, SOA, jQuery, HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Provide technical direction and on-boarding for junior 
Provide technical consultation on code and UI/UX reviews
Work as part of an agile team to provide direction in redesigning the mobile app

Technical Skills: AngularJS, jQuery, PHP, MySQL, REST, SOA, HTML5, SASS, Ionic

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Front end development using JavaScript (JQuery, AngularJS) and CSS (SASS), back end development in PHP and MySQL.

Worked in a team of 4-6 to develop a web/mobile app using Git, Vagrant, Apache Ant, and Jenkins CI.
Provided technical direction to project management and contributed to key software design.
Provide UX/UI design recommendations for web application screens

Technical Skills: AngularJS 1.6, jQuery, PHP, MySQL, REST, SOA, HTML5, SASS, Ionic

positions.title: Software Developer/Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Utilized .Net, C#, and Oracle to create an automated console application
Utilized Javascript, AJAX, C#, and VB.NET to modify the Corporate CRM application
Supported changing business process for the third party vendor SurveyMonkey
Supplied database modeling through entity framework

positions.title: Software Developer/Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Utilized .Net and SQL application development for the demand chain consumer spending solutions department on international programs
Documented technical specifications
Utilized data modeling for the implementation of database changes
Conducted developer testing
Coordinated user acceptance testing
Fixed user acceptance testing issues
Deployed the application and database changes to production
